title: Cow eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- grass ground -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='46' ry='7' fill='#2f7d32'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='40' ry='4' fill='#4caf50'/>

  <ellipse cx='48' cy='62' rx='26' ry='17' fill='#f2f2f2'/>

  <ellipse cx='40' cy='56' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#6b4f9e'/>

  <ellipse cx='33' cy='68' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#6b4f9e'/>

  <rect x='58' y='74' width='6' height='15' rx='3' fill='#e0e0e0'/>

  <rect x='52' y='76' width='6' height='13' rx='3' fill='#d0d0d0'/>

  <rect x='57' y='87' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a5a3a'/>

  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='45' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#e0e0e0' transform='rotate(20 33 45)'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M14 39 Q11 32 16 32' stroke='#d9c48a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 38 Q31 31 26 31' stroke='#d9c48a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='11' cy='56' r='1.2' fill='#b96a7a'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='56' r='1.2' fill='#b96a7a'/>

  <circle cx='22' cy='47' r='2.2' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <!-- snack hay in mouth -->
  <path d='M6 60 L2 55 M6 60 L1 62 M6 60 L3 66' stroke='#f0c419' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M5 59 L9 54' stroke='#e0a800' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
